entities.name: carter behind the lead mule
entities.what: Man in a light robe and a dark cap leaning forward on the far (north) side of the cart's lead mule, his arms reaching forward and down toward its neck: the carter driving or holding the team.
entities.vis: part: below the waist hidden by the lead mule's body

A third reading, a man in the shop door behind the team, fits less well: the shop's floor line is about v 190-200.

entities.name: lead mule of the cart's team
entities.what: Dark-brown draught animal in side view with a slim body, slender legs, a long head held low and a long tail: a mule (or a donkey); no horns. It stands at the front of the cart's team facing west, harnessed to the cart's front by long traces from its hindquarters; the carter leans over its far side.
entities.vis: part: the second animal overlaps its near side
entities.note: Body u 24177-24272, back line v 197-207, belly v 240-250; head u 24155-24178, v 195-235 (muzzle about (24166, 232)); forelegs u 24185-24197, one bent forward, hoof (24195, 271); hind hooves about (24262, 274); tail sweeping east to about (24290, 255). Traces curve from its hindquarters (24265, 245-255) to the cart's front (24330-24345, 265-275). The restyle's note calls the team an ox with riders in red; t6 also reads an ox. The strokes show no horns, a long head and a horse-like build, so mule or donkey (species conf med); no rider on it.

entities.name: second animal of the cart's team, turned toward the viewer
entities.what: A second, darker animal of the team on the near (south) side of the lead mule, turned toward the viewer and seen foreshortened, its head lowered between its forelegs: a mule or donkey, harnessed with a dark band.
entities.vis: part: hindquarters behind the lead mule
entities.note: Dark body u 24203-24250, v 213-265 (rump up at the north-east, toward the cart); head u 24225-24244, v 265-288; forelegs at u 24207-24216 and 24228-24236 with hooves at v 295-298, 25 px nearer the viewer than the lead mule's hooves, so it is a second animal, not part of the first. Hind est behind the lead mule.

entities.name: big two-wheeled cart being loaded
entities.what: Big two-wheeled cart with a long open bed (spoked wheels about the height of a man's chest), standing on the street facing west with its team of two mules hitched in front by long traces. Its load: a large flat bundle covered by a woven mat (a lattice of small cross marks), tilted up at the west end, over a dark hatched heap (straw or sacks). The bed's rails run on past its rear to u ≈ 24518 and a prop stick stands under the rear. A man stands on the bed's front handling the load; a saddled horse (t6's) stands behind its rear.
entities.vis: part: the far wheel hidden; the front half crossed by the team's traces
entities.note: SCALE CUE: near wheel rim u 24355-24427, v 193-267, hub (24390, 227): diameter about 73 px. Bed u 24347-24480, v 160-217; load u 24352-24467, v 118-175 (high at the west end). Front: the shafts or front legs run down from the bed's front (24347, 193) toward (24305-24320, 255-270), where the traces reach the cart (est). Rear: the bed's east end at about 24480; rear prop stick (24460, 210) -> (24470, 240); rails to (24518, 188). DEPTH DIRECTION: the bed's lower edge (24347, 217) -> (24480, 193), dv/du -0.18 (the cart stands nearly along the street, its rear a little north); not a receding edge. The restyle paints the load as straw sheaves.

entities.name: porters carrying sacks along the bank

A fourth sack-carrier bent under a sack shows above the small canopied boat's roof at about u 24440-24500, v 450-500 (feet hidden; on the boat or stepping onto it): river_m's.
